note: The game's effect selection (docs/design/unity-game.md, Weapon and Ability Effects), converted by game/Assets/Game/Editor/Effects/EffectConverter.cs into the gitignored Assets/Baked/Effects/; its fields are demo3d's (docs/tech-demo-3d/effects.md, The converter and The look). The sword's slash and spin are demo3d's spin-trail (ps-w9p.3), the trailer's gold crescent (Hovl's Sword Slash 11) in its own colours, without smoke (the hero stays in sight); the client draws them at the blade's arc (EffectCues.SlashArcM), turned onto each clip's arc and mirrored for a cut the other way round. The slam keeps demo3d's Hovl prefab without its smoke, through a heat ramp from ice to white. scaleRef is the radius in metres at which an effect has its stock size: the slash's and spin's crescent's own 2.8 m, the slam's the reach it is spawned at. crystal-burst is demo3d's crystal shatter burst (epic ps-2iq), built in and tinted per spawn by the role's gem colour. hit-flash and structure-burst are built in too, as are prism-cast and prism-hit, the weapons' casts and hits, and the lightning's strike-sparks and jump-sparks, tinted per spawn by the weapon's colour. tintGain: a tinted spawn's heat ramp runs at 0.6 of its emitter's gain, so its colour holds further into the core (ps-msz.8.3). vfx: the effects a look's vfx option draws in place of these (neon-look.md, The Axes > VFX; ps-wnj.15): the streak- and prism- entries, built in from arcs (ribbons of light bent round the spawn, effects.md Procedural arcs) and spark layers, the slash's and spin's on the crescent's arc (its middle at -135 degrees, sweeping clockwise) at 0.75 and 0.85 of the cue's scale. death-pop, death-ring and spawn-warp: the death flourish and the spawn warp (ps-wnj.16), built in from spark layers and arcs, drawn only under a look's vfx option: a pop on each dying body, a ring on the ground per instant's deaths within 3 m, a warp at each spawn in view.

effects.name: slam
effects.prefab: Assets/Hovl Studio/AOE Magic spells Vol.1/Prefabs/Magic hit.prefab

effects.name: crystal-burst
effects.notes: demo3d's crystal shatter burst: sprayed from where the killing blow lands and along it (the spawn's yaw), bright chips and fine crystal dust slowed by drag and fading out within 0.7 s, tinted per spawn by the role's gem colour

effects.name: hit-flash
effects.notes: a hit that doesn't kill: a few white-hot chips off the body along the blow, gone within 0.2 s (the body's own flash is the crowd's)

effects.name: structure-burst
effects.notes: a structure's break or regrowth: the crystal burst, larger and thrown wider from the strike point, tinted by the site's hue

effects.name: garlic-pulse
effects.notes: Garlic's pulse (Client/Weapons/GarlicAura.cs): motes born on the aura's edge as each incarnation lands, drifting out and up and fading within 0.8 s; spawned at the aura's radius (scaleRef, its rank 1 radius in metres) and tinted by the weapon's colour, white-hot at the core

effects.name: fire-trail-flame
effects.notes: Fire Trail's burning tile (Client/Weapons/FireTrailView.cs): embers rising from the tile's disc at each pulse, white-hot cooling into the weapon's colour within 0.7 s; spawned at the burn's radius (scaleRef, its rank 1 radius in metres)

effects.name: prism-cast
effects.notes: a weapon's cast (a Magic Wand bolt leaving the hero, a King Bible shard appearing): a quick prism of white-hot sparks along its way, tinted per spawn by the weapon's colour (Client/Weapons/WeaponLooks), gone within 0.3 s

effects.name: prism-hit
effects.notes: a weapon's hit (a Magic Wand bolt or a King Bible shard striking an enemy): prism chips thrown along the blow with a glint of fine dust, tinted per spawn by the weapon's colour, white at the core; its light takes the tint

effects.name: strike-sparks
effects.notes: a lightning strike's landing (Client/Weapons/LightningView): white-hot sparks sprayed up and out all around its point and a low spray of fine glints, gone within 0.5 s, tinted per spawn by the weapon's colour (Lightning Ring's electric blue, Thunder Loop's magenta), with a hard flash of light

effects.name: jump-sparks
effects.notes: a chain lightning jump landing on its enemy: a small burst of white-hot sparks off the body, gone within 0.25 s, tinted per spawn by the chain's lemon yellow

effects.name: streak-slash
effects.notes: light-streaks: the blade's cut as a ribbon of light along its arc, white at the core into the hero's trail colour, the head sweeping the arc in the first third of its life and the light trailing behind it: the everyday one, modest; streak-slash-big at a special moment

effects.name: streak-slash-big
effects.notes: light-streaks: the blade's cut as a ribbon of light along its arc, white at the core into the hero's trail colour, the head sweeping the arc in the first third of its life and the light trailing behind it, with a thinner echo inside it (the bright one, for a special moment)

effects.name: streak-spin
effects.notes: light-streaks: the spin's cut, a ribbon sweeping a little past a full turn: the everyday one, modest; streak-spin-big at a special moment

effects.name: streak-spin-big
effects.notes: light-streaks: the spin's cut, a ribbon sweeping a little past a full turn (the bright one, for a special moment)

effects.name: streak-slam
effects.notes: light-streaks: the slam's shock, a thin ring of light flat on the ground racing out to the reach, a brief inner flash and sparks thrown up off it

effects.name: prism-slash
effects.notes: prism-streaks: the cut split into three softer ribbons in the palette's key, accent and counter hues, each a little inside and behind the last: the everyday one, modest; prism-slash-big at a special moment

effects.name: prism-slash-big
effects.notes: prism-streaks: the cut split into three softer ribbons in the palette's key, accent and counter hues, each a little inside and behind the last (the bright one, for a special moment)

effects.name: prism-spin
effects.notes: prism-streaks: the spin's cut split into the palette's three hue families: the everyday one, modest; prism-spin-big at a special moment

effects.name: prism-spin-big
effects.notes: prism-streaks: the spin's cut split into the palette's three hue families (the bright one, for a special moment)

effects.name: prism-slam
effects.notes: prism-streaks: the slam's shock as three rings in the palette's hue families, racing out one behind the other

effects.name: streak-burst
effects.notes: light-streaks: the crystal burst with its chips drawn as short light streaks and a velocity smear along the blow, tinted per spawn by the role's gem

effects.name: streak-burst-big
effects.notes: light-streaks: the crystal burst with its chips drawn as short light streaks and a velocity smear along the blow, tinted per spawn by the role's gem (the bright one, for a special moment)

effects.name: streak-flash
effects.notes: light-streaks: a hit that doesn't kill: white-hot chips streaking off the body and a smear along the blow

effects.name: death-pop
effects.notes: the death flourish (neon-look.md, The Axes > VFX; ps-wnj.16): a light pop on the body on the impact frame, a soft flash a body wide gone in 0.1 s, tinted per spawn by the gem; drawn only under a look's vfx option

effects.name: death-ring
effects.notes: the death flourish's ring: a thin ring of light flat on the ground racing out from the death, lit on the impact frame and gone in 0.4 s, tinted per spawn by the gem; the deaths of one instant within 3 m share one, larger; drawn only under a look's vfx option

effects.name: spawn-warp
effects.notes: the spawn warp (neon-look.md, The Axes > VFX; ps-wnj.16): from a monster's spawn, two thin rings on the ground collapse onto it faster and faster and a soft glow pops where they meet 0.14 s in, as its sound peaks, before its first step; tinted per spawn by the gem; drawn only under a look's vfx option, for spawns in view
